newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Overseas sets US$60 mln term loan.
newsitem.headline: China Overseas sets US$60 mln term loan.

text.p: The following syndicated loan issue was announced by arranger Sanwa Bank Hong Kong.
BORROWER CHINA OVERSEAS LAND & INVESTMENT LTD
AMOUNT UP TO US$60 MLN TYPE TERM LOAN
MARGIN 1,3 OR 6ML+130 MATURITY 3 YRS AVGE LIFE --
PUTS -- CALLS -- REPLIES 19.FEB.97
DRAWDOWN MULTIPLE AVAIL 3 MTHS HOME CTRY HONG KONG
REPAYMENT BULLET GOV LAW HONG KONG
ARRANGER SANWA BANK HONG KONG BRANCH (AGENT)
MGT LEVELS AND FEES
COMMITMENT FEE 37.5 BASIS POINTS ON DAILY UNDRAWN BALANCE
CO-ARRANGERS US$10 MLN+ 90BP
LEAD MANAGERS US$6-9 MLN 75BP
MANAGERS US$3-5 MLN 60BP
NOTES PROCEEDS WILL BE USED FOR GENERAL WORKING CAPITAL.
THE ISSUE IS RANKED PARI PASSU WITH ALL OF THE
BORROWER'S PRESENT AND FUTURE UNSECURED AND
UNSUBORDINATED
OBLIGATIONS.
FINANCIAL COVENANTS: RATIO OF CONSOLIDATED BORROWINGS
TO CONSOLIDATED NET WORTH SHALL NOT BE MORE THAN 2:1,
CONSOLIDATED SECURED BORROWINGS SHALL NOT EXCEED 50
PERCENT OF CONSOLIDATED NET WORTH, CONSOLIDATED NET
WORTH SHALL NOT BE LESS THAN HK$5,000 MILLION.
-- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6960
